newsitem.title: USA: Liggett Group proposes debt restructuring.
newsitem.headline: Liggett Group proposes debt restructuring.

text.p: Liggett Group Inc, a subsidiary of Brooke Group Ltd, on Wednesday announced a proposed debt restructuring involving interest deferral that would go toward construction of a cigarette factory in Russia.
Liggett proposed to extend the maturity of its senior secured notes to February 2004 from 1999.
Additionally, it offered to pay-in-kind two interest payments on the notes, totalling $19.4 million, commencing in August, a Liggett spokesman said.
The interest deferral and additional outside financing would be used for construction of a new Russian cigarette factory by the company's affiliate, Liggett-Ducat Ltd.
Liggett said it planned to hold preliminary discussions regarding the restructing plan with certain noteholders this morning.

It said it hoped to have the new Russian factory operational by the end of 1998. The factory, which will use Western cigarette-making technology, will have the capacity to manufacture 24 billion units a year, a Liggett spokesman said.
